qualifier: retina, lens and ocular vasculature
name: Camera-type eye development: retina, lens and ocular vasculature
rationale: Nearly all members concern morphogenesis and differentiation of eye tissues (retinal neurons and photoreceptors, lens, cornea, iris, eyelid, lacrimal gland, blood-retinal barrier, hyaloid regression); unlike the ear-development confusables it is ocular, and unlike the overlapping confusable it lacks phototransduction and retinoid-cycle function, being developmental.

qualifier: leptin and ghrelin signaling
name: Leptin- and ghrelin-mediated appetite and food intake regulation
rationale: Members regulate feeding behavior, appetite, nutrient-level responses and body growth through leptin and ghrelin, which distinguishes the theme from confusables built on growth hormone receptor or gut-peptide GPCR (glucagon, calcitonin, amylin, somatostatin) signaling.

qualifier: angiotensin signaling and vascular tone, including pulmonary
name: Angiotensin-activated signaling in arterial and pulmonary blood pressure
rationale: All members concern renin-angiotensin control of systemic and lung blood pressure and vasoconstriction, whereas confusables emphasize renal sodium/urine excretion, natriuretic cGMP signaling or angiotensinogen processing.

core: Integrin- and syndecan-mediated cell-matrix adhesion in migration
qualifier: adhesion turnover and invadopodia
name: Cell-matrix adhesion turnover in migration and invadopodia formation
rationale: Members cover integrin/syndecan substrate adhesion, spreading, stress fibers and migration, and uniquely include focal adhesion disassembly, invadopodia and negative junction regulation, unlike confusables centred on MET-PTK2, fibronectin matrix assembly and fibroblast/EMT programmes.

qualifier: TRAF3/TRAF6 relay to type I interferon and NF-kB
name: RIG-I-like receptor–TRAF signaling to type I interferon
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5 sensing relayed through TRAF3/TRAF6 and FADD/RIP1 to IRF and NF-kB activation and IFN-alpha/beta production, including its negative regulators and RSV/SARS-CoV modulation, distinct from confusables on cytosolic DNA sensing, dsRNA/ZBP1, TLR7-9 and OAS responses.

qualifier: heme, iron-sulfur clusters and ubiquinone
name: Mitochondrial heme, iron-sulfur cluster and ubiquinone biosynthesis
rationale: Members are heme/porphyrin synthesis, Fe-S cluster assembly, ferredoxin electron transfer, ubiquinol/quinone synthesis and Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation, unlike confusables on respiratory complex assembly, erythrocyte gas transport or iron/heme uptake.

qualifier: gametogenesis, meiosis, fertilization and gonadal hormones
name: Gametogenesis, meiosis, fertilization and gonadal endocrine control
rationale: Members span germ cell specification, meiotic recombination and segregation, spermatogenesis and oogenesis, fertilization, maternal-to-zygotic transition, germline piRNA/retroelement silencing and gonadotropin/gonad development, distinguishing it from mitotic cell-cycle and placental/trophoblast confusables.

qualifier: E2F-driven origin licensing
name: E2F-driven DNA replication origin licensing and initiation
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, replication initiation and its checkpoint/ATR control, and E2F G1/S transcription, unlike confusables on E2F6, G2/M promotion or intra-S damage checkpoints.

qualifier: phagocyte NADPH oxidase superoxide generation
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst regulation
rationale: Members concern regulation of superoxide generation and the respiratory burst by phagocytes (CYBB-expressing macrophages, PMN phagocytolysis), whereas confusables centre on neutrophil degranulation, bacterial and fungal killing or general monocyte inflammation.

qualifier: serotonin and histamine synthesis, transport and receptors
name: Serotonin and histamine synthesis, transport and receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern serotonin or histamine biosynthesis, uptake, secretion, metabolism or receptor signaling, which separates the theme from muscarinic acetylcholine and tachykinin receptor confusables tied to gastrointestinal motility.

qualifier: NMDA and AMPA receptor activation
name: NMDA and AMPA glutamate receptor activation and signaling
rationale: Members describe NMDA/AMPA receptor assembly, activation, Ca2+-triggered downstream signaling and long-term potentiation, distinct from confusables on dendritic spine structural plasticity and CaMK-CREB/NPAS4 nuclear signaling.

qualifier: AP-site processing, gap filling and OGG1/MUTYH defects
name: Base excision repair: AP-site processing, gap filling, OGG1/MUTYH defects
rationale: Members are post-glycosylase BER steps (APEX1 displacement, single-nucleotide and long-patch repair, gap filling) plus defective OGG1/MUTYH variants, unlike confusables on lesion recognition and cleavage, NTHL1/NEIL defects or mitochondrial DNA repair.

core: NK and cytotoxic T cell activity
qualifier: positive activation and cytotoxicity
name: NK and CD8 T cell activation promoting cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK/T cell signatures, CD8 T cell proliferation and positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity and cytokine production, whereas confusables carry inhibitory KIR/MHC class Ib interactions, tolerance and protection from NK killing.

qualifier: metaphase alignment and anaphase onset control
name: Meiotic metaphase chromosome alignment and anaphase segregation control
rationale: All members concern meiotic metaphase alignment, poleward movement and the regulated metaphase-anaphase transition, distinct from confusables on meiotic prophase recombination, cohesion establishment, meiotic entry and oocyte spindle assembly.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, branched-chain amino acids and ketone bodies
name: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, branched-chain amino acids, ketones
rationale: Members cover PDH/OGDH/OADH/BCKDH complexes and their lipoyl/biotin/CoA cofactors, branched-chain and lysine catabolism disorders, short-chain beta-oxidation and ketone bodies, unlike confusables on carnitine-dependent long-chain fatty acid oxidation or the malate-aspartate shuttle.

qualifier: kynurenine route to de novo NAD+
name: Tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine to de novo NAD+
rationale: All members describe tryptophan breakdown through kynurenine and quinolinate to NAD+, distinguishing the theme from phenylalanine/tyrosine, threonine/glycine and nicotinate salvage confusables.

qualifier: with inherited P450 and transporter deficiencies
name: Post-lanosterol cholesterol synthesis and inherited P450/transporter deficiencies
rationale: Members combine Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell late cholesterol synthesis with disease variants of lipid/sterol-handling CYPs and transporters (CYP1B1, CYP26C1, CYP7B1, TBXAS1, SLCO2A1, ABCB6), separating it from early mevalonate, bile acid synthesis and spastic paraplegia confusables; the two halves are only loosely unified.

qualifier: 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage
name: Lipoylation-dependent 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase and glycine cleavage
rationale: Members are protein lipoylation and the lipoamide/DLD-dependent OGDH, OADH and glycine cleavage systems, distinct from confusables centred on PDH/BCKDH, the wider TCA cycle or GABA/lysine catabolism.

qualifier: mono- and dimethylation of non-histone targets such as p53
name: Peptidyl-lysine mono- and dimethylation, including p53 regulation
rationale: All members concern lysine mono/dimethylation with p53 as the named substrate, whereas confusables address histone methylation/acetylation complexes and DNA methylation.

qualifier: transcription and translation initiation to termination
name: Mitochondrial transcription and translation initiation, elongation, termination
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination and translation initiation, elongation, termination and ribosome quality control, unlike confusables on tRNA aminoacylation, RNA processing/modification or mtDNA replication and repair.

qualifier: anterograde Golgi-to-endosome export and endosomal tubulation
name: Anterograde Golgi-to-endosome traffic and endosome membrane tubulation
rationale: Members cover Golgi vesicle budding and positioning, Golgi-to-endosome and constitutive secretion, endocytosis, early-to-late endosome transport, membrane tubulation and receptor recycling, distinct from confusables on retrograde endosome-to-Golgi, COPI Golgi-ER traffic and Golgi organization.

qualifier: thymocyte lineages and TCR-driven activation
name: Thymocyte and T cell differentiation and activation
rationale: Members are T cell differentiation (double-positive thymocytes, CD8 and gamma-delta lineages, ITK/PKC) and activation signatures with two mixed lymphocyte development sets, unlike confusables on B cell lineage commitment, germinal centre/Tfh or IL2-TCR networks.

qualifier: electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
name: Mitochondrial respiratory electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis
rationale: All members describe operation of the respiratory chain (ubiquinol to oxygen) and ATP synthesis, distinguishing it from confusables about respiratory complex assembly, inner-membrane insertion and mitochondrial translation.

qualifier: isocitrate/2-oxoglutarate metabolism and NADPH regeneration
name: TCA cycle isocitrate and 2-oxoglutarate metabolism, NADPH regeneration
rationale: Members concern isocitrate, 2-oxoglutarate and malate metabolism, IDH-linked NADPH regeneration and aberrant 2-hydroxyglutarate production, unlike confusables on succinate/malate-aspartate shuttle, PDH or lipoylated dehydrogenase complexes.

qualifier: aminoacylation and wobble modification for fidelity
name: tRNA aminoacylation and wobble modification for decoding fidelity
rationale: Members cover cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation and wobble-position modifications supporting translational fidelity, distinct from confusables on mitochondrial translation, tRNA methylation and mitochondrial RNA processing.
